9467.t: From ἔνδον (éndon, “within”) + -γενής (-genḗs). Compare with Latin indigenus.

9495.t: From ἐξαιρέω (exairéō, “to take out, discharge [cargo], except, bereave [someone] of [something, e.g. life], transcend, claim [someone] as a freeman”) + -σις (-sĭs, suffix forming nouns of action).
